column1: # VPB data pack - plain TSV, one entry per line. Review it in a diff; that is the point.
# One row per VaM Hub resource. 'entry_id' is the Hub resource id.
# 'vars' = pipe-separated  creator.name:version:exact  (version-less key, lowercased,
#          exact=1 - taken from the Hub's own hubFiles filenames).
#          Whitespace-stripped alias keys are derived at load time, not stored.
# 'tags' = pipe-separated  ns:tag  where ns is hub | meta (split on the FIRST colon).
# 'ident_key' = SPACE-separated  creator|name  keys (the key itself contains a pipe).
#          Every leading word-prefix of the title is a key, so 'Beep Beep - Lapdance'
#          also answers to the .var actually named creator.BeepBeep.
# 'flags' = bit 1 hub-hosted, bit 2 hub-downloadable. 'size_kb' sums the hub files.
# 'downloads' is rounded to 3 significant digits on purpose - a raw counter would
#          rewrite almost every line on every rebuild for no query value.
# Resources with an empty 'vars' cell ship anyway: they still join by ident_key or
# resource_id, and cost nothing until then.
